entrypoints.name: initNodeCompression
entrypoints.summary: Enable zlib compression under Node.

entrypoints.name: setDeflateImpl
entrypoints.summary: Inject a zlib-wrapped (RFC 1950) DEFLATE implementation so layout.compress produces real compression outside Node (browsers, workers). A raw-DEFLATE function is rejected at build time — use setDeflateRawImpl for those.

entrypoints.name: setDeflateRawImpl
entrypoints.summary: Inject a raw RFC 1951 compressor (e.g. fflate deflateSync); the engine adds the zlib envelope. Engine >= 1.8.0.

entrypoints.name: wrapZlib
entrypoints.summary: Wrap raw DEFLATE output in the RFC 1950 zlib envelope. Engine >= 1.8.0.

entrypoints.name: setDefaultCreationDate
entrypoints.summary: Pin the creation instant process-wide for byte-reproducible output; null restores the wall clock. Per-document: <Document creationDate>. Engine >= 1.8.0.

entrypoints.name: getDefaultCreationDate
entrypoints.summary: The process-wide creation-date pin, or null. Engine >= 1.8.0.

entrypoints.name: setHyphenationProvider
entrypoints.summary: Install a hyphenation provider ((word, lang?) => break offsets) used by typography.splitParagraphs; the engine ships no dictionary. Engine >= 1.8.0.

entrypoints.name: getHyphenationProvider
entrypoints.summary: The installed hyphenation provider, or null. Engine >= 1.8.0.

lintRules.description: The document has no blocks — it would render as a blank page.
An image has no alt text, so assistive technology cannot describe it.
A chart has no altText. The engine auto-generates a generic description; a written one is far more useful.
A table has no header row, which breaks screen-reader navigation.
Heading levels skip a step (e.g. h1 followed by h3).
A form field has no label, leaving the widget unidentified.
A link has no text, or its text is just the raw URL.
PDF/A is requested but no fontEntries are supplied. PDF/A requires every rendering font to be embedded (veraPDF rule 6.2.11.4.1).
PDF/A and encryption are mutually exclusive (ISO 19005-1 §6.3.2).
Embedded file attachments require tagged: 'pdfa3b' — only PDF/A-3 permits them (ISO 19005-3).
The block count is within 10% of the configured maxBlocks ceiling.
The block count is past the configured maxBlocks ceiling.
A chart has no series, or a series has no values.
A pie or donut chart must have exactly one series.
A chart series has a different length from the chart's categories.
A chart contains a non-finite value, or a negative value in a pie/donut.
A chart exceeds the engine ceiling of 10 000 data points.
A log-scaled axis is combined with a stacked chart, has a bound <= 0, or a series bound to it contains a value <= 0.

Invalid x-axis configuration: a positional axis type on an unsupported chart kind, a scatter chart with a category axis, missing or mismatched xValues, date strings without a time axis, or yAxis "right" on a pie/donut.
Invalid x-label options: labelStride/labelRotation on a scatter chart, a non-integer or < 1 labelStride, or a labelRotation outside 0-90.
The print-production options are invalid (bleed/box geometry, marks without a TrimBox, or userUnit constraints) — the engine would reject them mid-render.
Invalid print-dialog viewer preferences: a malformed printPageRange pair (1-based, first <= last) or a non-positive-integer numCopies.
layout.outputIntent is set but the document is not tagged — the engine silently ignores it.
A PDF/A document contains form fields; the AcroForm font is not embedded, so the engine will report PDFA_UNEMBEDDED_FORM_FONT (and throw under layout.strict).
A block overflows the page content box (requires `overflow: true`).

layout.outputIntent.iccProfile is not a usable ICC profile: shorter than the 128-byte header, no `acsp` signature, a size field outside the buffer, or a data colour space other than RGB, CMYK or Gray — the engine rejects it at build time.
pdfx names a conformance target the engine does not know (only 'pdfx4' exists) — the engine would throw before writing.
pdfx and tagged are both set — the engine writes one conformance claim per file and throws on the combination.
PDF/X forbids encryption (ISO 15930-7) — pdfx and layout.encryption cannot be combined.
PDF/X-4 needs an outputIntent carrying the printer’s output profile (ICC device class 'prtr'); it is missing, or the profile is a monitor profile such as sRGB — the engine would throw.
PDF/X requires the trapping state to be known, but metadata.trapped is 'Unknown' — the engine would throw.
PDF/X pages carry a TrimBox or an ArtBox, not both — print.artBox is set together with print.trimBox or print.bleed.
pdfx is requested but no fontEntries are supplied. PDF/X-4 requires every font to be embedded; the engine reports PDFX_NO_FONT_ENTRIES (and throws under layout.strict).
A PDF/X-4 document contains a link or a form field; ISO 15930-7 forbids those annotations inside the BleedBox and the engine reports PDFX_ANNOTATIONS (and throws under layout.strict).

A typography option can have no effect as written: orphans/widows without splitParagraphs, an unknown fontFeatures tag, kerning or fontFeatures or the 'fr' preset without a registered font, or a line quota below 1.
print.marks.colourBars is set but the bottom bleed strip is too thin: under 4 pt the engine skips the bars silently, under 5 mm (14.17 pt) the patches fall below a densitometer aperture.
A CMYK colour is used under a PDF/A or PDF/X claim whose output intent is not CMYK; the engine reports PDFA_DEVICE_CMYK_CONTENT / PDFX_DEVICE_CMYK (and throws under layout.strict).
